Title: Relates to health care for children; repealer
Summary: Removes the household income as a factor for determining eligibility for healthcare for children.
LawCode: Rpld §2511 sub 2 ¶(f), amd §§2510 & 2511, Pub Health L
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the public health law, in relation to universal health care for children; and to repeal certain provisions of such law relating thereto
